messages:
Leo Park (AE): Incoming RFI from CypressGrid. Req: capability matrix + short answers on quantization, p50/p95 numbers for 16k POC, EU-only tenancy, and exact HSM wording. Also asked for 2-week POC pricing (hosted, small dedicated, private+HSM). Can we pull numbers and wording today?

Nina Rao (SSE): Ill own the tech bundle. Quick clarifying Q: POC targets? concurrency/embeds?

Leo Park (AE): They specified 250 concurrent gen streams, ~60k embed calls/day, 16k mostly. Need p95<=600ms target.

Samir Das (Eng-ML): Draft matrix for the RFI table. Keep it short; we'll annotate caveats below.

Samir Das (Eng-ML): ```
Capability | Hosted API | Dedicated (reserved small) | Private (VPC + HSM)
---------- | ---------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------
Context (typical) | up to 32k (model dep) | up to 32k | up to 32k
Gen latency p50 (16k) | 130-220 ms | 85-140 ms | 95-150 ms
Gen latency p95 (16k) | 500-850 ms | 320-520 ms | 350-560 ms
Embed p50 | 35-80 ms | 18-40 ms | 20-45 ms
Concurrency | burst to 100s | reserved 100-800 | configurable
Quantization | bf16 / int8 | int8 recommended | int8 + custom kernels
KMS/HSM | Redwood KMS | customer KMS integ | customer HSM (add-on)
SLA | standard | SLA-backed | enterprise SLA
```

Victor Chen (Security): HSM wording (approved): "Customer-managed HSM or HSM-backed KMS is supported for Private deployments. Keys used for encryption, signing, and audit are stored in customer-controlled HSMs or vetted HSM-backed KMS; Redwood control plane never receives plaintext keys. Attestation and audit artifacts available under NDA." Legal to gate SOC2/ISO attachments.

Nina Rao (SSE): Ops caveat to add: latency ranges depend on model variant, quant, and batching. For RFI we should state: numbers assume 16k context, bf16 baseline, int8 cost-optimized. Also note routing policy: reserved pools preferred; on saturation we can (a) queue with backpressure, (b) route to hosted EU-compatible pool with notice, or (c) fall back to quantized variant per customer preference.

Olga Petrov (Finance): Preliminary 2-week POC estimates (EU pricing): hosted unoptimized ~ $28k, optimized (caching+quant) ~ $11k; small dedicated 2-week reservation ~ $42k (incl. monitoring & ops); Private EU POC + HSM add-on ~ $76k + integration fee ~ $13k. Will confirm margins and FX.

Leo Park (AE): Good. Nina please include an acceptance criteria list: p95 gen <= 600ms, embed p50 <= 60ms, stable throughput at 250 concurrent.

Nina Rao (SSE): Draft acceptance criteria: "Gen p95 <= 600ms (16k), Embed p50 <= 60ms, sustained concurrency 250 with <=5% error rate, streaming parity for gen APIs." Adding that to the bundle.

Samir Das (Eng-ML): Short perf note for RFI: "Ranges assume typical batch/kv cache settings and either bf16 or int8. Private deployments can leverage custom kernel tuning to reduce int8 latency; hosted variants use vetted quant profiles. Customers can enable aggressive prefix caching to reduce cost for retrieval-heavy patterns."

Victor Chen (Security): Data residency note: "Dedicated and Private can be pinned to EU-only tenancy. Hosted can be region-restricted to EU regions but is not air-gapped by default. Logs retention configurable; default 30 days."

file-bot: Uploaded: cypressgrid_rfi_attachments_v1.zip :paperclip:

Olga Petrov (Finance): I'll attach a simple CSV with the cost breakout once Nina posts the draft answers.

Nina Rao (SSE): Plan: assemble matrix + short Q&A + HSM wording + ops blurb + pricing rows. Posting draft here by 5pm CET. Can reviewers quick-check?

Leo Park (AE): Target to send final RFI by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
